idea-plugin.name: Environment Switcher
idea-plugin.description:
Switch the environment your run configurations target from a dropdown in the toolbar, the way Postman switches environments. Define dev, test, staging, prod once; every run configuration you launch receives the selected environment's variables.

Features

  • Environment dropdown next to the run widget, with a colour per environment.
  • Run | Edit Environments… dialog: variables per environment, common variables, per-module overrides, copy environment, import from a folder of .env files.
  • Secrets stay in the IDE password safe (your OS keychain); the shared project file lists only their names. Optionally keep everything in the project file for private repos.
  • Works with Application, JAR Application and Spring Boot run configurations out of the box; enable any Java-based type in settings.
  • Optional confirmation before running against an environment such as production.
  • Missing-secret policy (warn or block), ${NAME} expansion, auto-marking of sensitive variable names.
  • Team-friendly: commit .idea/environmentSwitcher.xml; each developer keeps their own selection and secrets.

Variables set explicitly on a run configuration always win over the environment.

Source, issues and documentation on GitHub.
